title: Reciprocal Dynamics in Polynomial Congruence Jumping: Integral Orbits and Valuation Cones
summary: Alternating reciprocal transformations of polynomial divisibility systems couple an orbit of integer points to a rational dynamical system on polynomial coefficients. For fixed positive degrees $n,m$, we prove universal four-step return to rational gauge classes. Weighted primitive representatives preserve integral continuation through nondegenerate jumps using only exact division and coefficient gcds; the stronger requirement of monic integral representatives is governed by endpoint $p$-adic valuation defects.
